Commentary.Commentary: A lot is at stake here and the Pakistan batters have done their job. Runs on the board and in a pressure game you have to favor the side bowling second, especially with the attack they have. New Zealand batters on the other hand, will have to bat out of their skins on a wicket which is a touch slow. Who will take the series? Join us to find out.

The Kiwi bowlers were not at their very best. They were too straight at the start and later on were a little too short. Sodhi especially, the wicket offered him a lot but he could not find the right line. Trent Boult had a day to forget as he went for a plenty. Had it not been for Lockie Ferguson, who was brilliant, New Zealand might have been chasing something above 300. He was the standout with a fifer.

So a good comeback in the last 10 overs has seen New Zealand restrict Pakistan to below 300 but let me tell you, this target for New Zealand is going to be a very tough one. Pakistan elected to bat after winning the toss and their batters have justified the decision. Three of their batters scored a half ton with Azam being the top scorer as he fell just short of a ton. Also, there were quite a few partnership throughout. The 106-run stand though between Sohail and Azam set the platform. However, they could not capitalize on it due to some exceptional bowling at the death.

OUT! CAUGHT! Could not have asked for a better finish! A wicket on the last ball and Ferguson gets his fifth. It is the short ball which does the trick this time. Ali goes for the pull but gets a top edge towards Worker at deep square leg. He runs in and takes a good catch. Third wicket in the over and only 4 from the last. PAKISTAN FINISH WITH 279!
Slower bumper now, it is pulled through mid-wicket for a single. Has been a good last over till now, can they end it well?

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! This though was not what Pakistan wanted. Ferguson gets his second in the over and his 4th of the game. On the stumps again and on a fuller length. The batsman swings but misses to see the furniture behind get disturbed.
Short again, the pull shot is not connected. A bye is taken. Asif ALi on strike, this is what Pakistan would want.
A short ball and it is the slower one. Ali mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Hasan Ali walks out to the middle.
OUT! TIMBER! You hit, I miss! Full and on off, Ashraf swings and misses to see his stumps get shattered. A wicket to start the last, New Zealand would want to end well here.

SIX! Take that! Ideal end to the over for Pakistan. Full and on the pads, Ali flicks it nonchalantly over the square leg fence. The last two balls spoils the whole over. 10 from the last two and 13 from it. Also a wicket.

THEY HAVE RUN 5! Well, no matter if you are set or not, you would put such balls away 9 out of 10 times. A full toss on the pads, Ashraf flicks it towards deep square leg. The batsmen run two. Latham then fails to collect the throw and another overthrow results. That is not the end. A poor throw at the other end sees them take two extra runs. All these are bonus runs here.
Faheem Ashraf is the new man in.

OUT! Azam departs in the 90s. The pressure of not hitting the boundaries has gotten to him. The slower ball on middle, Azam brings out the heave but only gets height and not the distance. Nicholls at deep mid-wicket, judges it well and takes it. End of another top knock from Azam though. He will be disappointed of not getting a ton but he has surely done the job. However, there are two new batsmen at the crease for Pakistan and New Zealand will be happy about that.
Once again Pakistan have to be content with a single as Ali jams this yorker out towards covers.
A high full toss outside off, Ali swings but misses it completely. That was probably one loose delivery from the Kiwi bowlers in the last few overs. It still does not go to the fence.
A yorker outside off, Babar gets it off the inner half towards square leg for a run. This is brilliant bowling.
And it stays that way! A yorker to end it. Azam jams it out beside the pitch and a run is taken.
On the shorter side, Ali pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run. This is turning out to be another good over for New Zealand.
Very full and at a good pace. Not a lot you can do with this ball, it is driven down to long on for a run.
Back of a length on off, Azam punches it through covers for a couple. Good running.
A single and a dot to begin this over. Full and outside off, Azam goes for the drive but is beaten.
On the shorter side, it is pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on off, it is driven through covers for another single. Another good over for New Zealand, 6 runs and a wicket from it.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They manage to come back for the second.
Good length again on off, Ali guides it down to third man for another run.
Back of a length on off, Azam guides it through point. A run taken.
Asif Ali comes out to bat.

OUT! In the air... taken! Henry gets Malik on the next ball. He could have so easily been on a hat-trick. A full ball outside off, Malik tries to go over covers. Ends up slicing it over cover-point. Worker in the deep runs to his left and makes no mistake this time.

DROPPED! This is so unlike New Zealand. This was a simple chance. Short and on middle, Azam pulls it right off the middle. However, he does not get the desired elevation. Worker at deep mid-wicket, moves to his right, gets two hands to it but drops it. He though shows good awareness as he manages to pull the ball back in before it crosses the ropes. A single taken by the batsmen. This could prove pretty costly as Azam is really striking the ball well here.
Another single to end the over! Full and on off, it is driven down to long off for a run. Another good over by Boult.
A yorker outside off, it is hit through covers for a run.
A yorker on middle, Malik works it through square leg. They run the first one hard, sense the opportunity for the second, go for it and complete it.
On the shorter side, it is pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Shuffles across and tries to swing but gets it off the inner half towards square leg. A run taken.
A full toss to begin with but Malik does not time it properly. It goes towards mid off for a run.
A dot to end but a good one for Pakistan! 11 from it. A yorker outside off, Azam fails to put bat on it.
Wide! Way too outside off, left alone.
Very full and outside off, Malik somehow gets his bat to it. It is over point and a run is taken.
Slower bouncer, sticks into the surface. Azam pulls it through backward square leg. The batsmen run one, Azam wants the second but is sent back.
A full toss on off, Malik drives it through covers. A run is taken.
Tries to go over covers now but ends up slicing it over point for a single. 7 from the first two balls, pressure on the bowler now to make a comeback here.
SIX! Welcome into the attack, says Babar. Magnificent. Full and on off, Azam clears his front leg and then lofts it with a very straight bat over the long off fence.
Matt Henry to bowl now.
A dot to end! Fires in a yorker and it is kept out. Very good over by Boult.
Full again on off, Malik drives it through covers for a couple as it was slightly away from the sweeper.
Very full and outside off, Azam jams it down to third man for a run.
Bringing all his variation into play. It is the slower ball on off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
A short ball to follow the full one. It is pulled through mid-wicket. A run taken.
Full and on middle, it is clipped to mid-wicket.
A bumper to end! On the body. Malik tries to pull but it goes off the under edge towards the keeper. 10 from this over, this is the kind of overs Pakistan will want ahead.
On the shorter side outside off, it is guided past point for a couple. This is turning out to be an expensive over.
Short again, Azam may have expected it. He pulls it through mid-wicket and takes a run.
How late was that! Waits for the ball to arrive, it is bowled close to the off pole. Azam guides it down to third man for a couple.

FOUR! Picked his spot well there! Ferguson goes full and it is on the stumps, Azam knows there is no one in the deep at the mid-wicket region. So all he has to do is go over the fielder at mid-wicket. Does so and bags a boundary.
Short of a length outside off, Malik plays it through point for a single.
This is flatter and on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for another two.
Another short ball outside off, Azam pulls it in between mid-wicket and long on. A couple.
Very short again! Malik goes back and pulls it but straight to the man at deep square leg. A run.
This is floated on off, Malik drives it to covers.
On the shorter side, Malik goes back and guides it through point. A couple taken.
Gives it some nice air and lands it on off, Malik lunges and keeps it out.
Ish Sodhi is back on.
Off the mark is Malik of his very first ball. It is on his pads, it is clipped down to fine leg. A run is taken. A good over for New Zealand.
Guides this one down to third man for a run.
Shortish and outside off, Azam tries to cut it but misses.
Shoaib Malik walks out to the middle.

OUT! The 108-run stand has been broken! Ferguson is the man who gets the wicket. Not the best of deliveries though. It is on the pads, Haris flicks it uppishly towards Worker at deep square leg. He runs in and takes a very good catch, inches above the ground. A good innings by Sohail comes to an end. His partnership with Azam has laid an excellent foundation for the batsman to come.
Down the leg side and another wide.
Full and wide outside off, Azam tries to go over the cover fielder but gets an outside edge down to third man. A run taken.
Slower ball outside off, it is very slow. Azam fails to put bat on ball.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring.
A yorker outside off, it is jammed out to point. 13 from Boult's first over of his new spell. Again an expensive start for him.
SIX! Stand and deliver! Pakistan now on the attack here. This is a length ball by Boult on middle, Haris clears his front leg and hits it over cow corner for a biggie.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Delightful! On the fuller length, Azam with a straight bat times it down the ground. You need not run for those.
From around the wicket, this is slanted closer to the off stump. Azam goes for a drive but is beaten.

Fifty up for Pakistan's run machine. His 9th in this format. Once again he has played the role of an anchor, he though needs to stay till the end if Pakistan want to get close to 300. This is slightly short and outside off, Azam cuts it through point and a brace is taken.
Trent Boult is back on.
A dot to end! This is defended towards covers.
Down the leg side, the batsman misses the flick and it has been wided.
A bumper now and it has been ducked under.
Shortish and outside off, Azam slaps it through covers and takes a single.
Back of a length on off, Azam punches it to covers.
Fullish and on middle, it is driven back to the bowler.
On middle, Sohail works it through mid-wicket. A single taken.
The googly on off, Sohail pushes it through covers for a run.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.
Azam punches it with the turn through covers for a single.
Uses his feet now and tries to go over long on. Does not get the timing and it goes down to long on for a run.

DROPPED AND SIX! A half-chance you can say! It is a half-tracker on middle, it is begging to be hit and Sohail does exactly that. He pulls it with power towards deep mid-wicket. Grandhomme there leaps and gets a hand to it but the ball does not stick and goes over the ropes. That also brings up the fifty for Sohail. In a slightly fortunate manner but he won't mind. A good comeback game for him. He has also brought it up at a good pace, he would hope to continue though. It is short and on
Gives it a nice loop and lands it on off, the batsman defends it.

A brilliant effort in the field there! It is short and wide outside off, Azam cuts it towards point. HN there dives full stretch to his left and makes a half-stop. Saved at least a couple for his side there.
Full and on off, Azam strokes it to point. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the striker's end but the batter is well in.
On the shorter side outside off, Sohail guides it down to third man for a run.
Well kept! This is down the leg side, Sohail tries to flick but fails to do so. The ball brushes the pads and goes to the left of Latham. He dives and makes a good stop.
On the shorter side, Sohail stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
Starts off with a slower one outside off, it is slapped through covers for a run.
Lockie Ferguson is back on.
Drinks!
Again bowls it short, Sohail fails to put it away as he pulls it towards short fine leg.
Dances down the track but does not get to the length. The ball is worked towards mid-wicket.
Loopy ball outside off, turning back in. Sohail defends it out. This is what he should be bowling to the left-hander.
Floats it up around off, Azam strokes it through covers for a single.
A little too short, that is exactly how Sodhi has bowled today. Sohail easily works it around the corner and a run is taken.

Once again good amount of turn there! This is floated up around middle and off, pitches and goes away. Azam tries to drive it straight down the ground but gets an outside edge towards short third man for a run.
Another ball on the shorter side, Sohail hops and plays it down onto the ground. Two dots to end.
Good length on off, Sohail guides it to point.
Now follows the boundary up with a single as this is worked around the corner.
FOUR! Very smart! A yorker outside off, not a lot you can do with it but Azam jams it out with an open face of the bat and the ball races down to the third man fence.
Good length on off, Haris guides it to third man for a single.
On the shorter side, it is slapped through covers for a run.
Slightly shorter in length again, Sohail works it around the corner for a run.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Good bowling and good fielding! This is floated up on off, Azam strokes it towards covers. The fielder there dives to his right and saves a run.
On the shorter side, so the turn does not matter. Azam goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket. A couple taken.
Flighted ball on middle, Azam tries to work it on the leg side but the ball turns away, takes a soft leading edge towards covers.

Turn there! However, more than the Pakistan batters, it will be the New Zealand batsmen who will be worried after watching the ball turn that way. The wicket would probably worsen. This is tossed up on off, the ball pitches and turns away. It is slow turn however and Azam has enough time to adjust and keep it out.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single as the ball is away from the fielder.
Another bouncer! Too high for anyone. Azam leaves it alone and Henry is given the warning.
Bouncer! Azam ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Haris guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Closer to the stumps, Sohail gets behind the ball and defends it.
Outside off, cut past backward point. Singles are not hard to come for the hosts.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Azam plays the square cut straight to the fielder.
Good batting. Tapping the balls in the gaps and rotating strike. Plays this with soft hands to extra cover and crosses.
Slower ball on off, Azam shuffles and flicks it through square leg for one more.
On middle and leg, played with a straight bat to long on for one.
Nice sound of the willow. Fuller ball outside off, Azam drives it through covers but just for one.
Outside off, cut past point. A single to end the over.
Some chin music for Babar, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
Played to the point region by HS. They pick up a single.
Short ball on off, pulled through mid-wicket and rotates strike.
Deft. Similar ball again, Sohail plays it late to third man and changes ends.
Short ball outside off, Sohail sways away from it. Good leave.
Matt Henry in for a burst.
Haris has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
In the gap. Outside off, Sohail cuts it past backward point and comes back for a brace.
On a good length around off, pushed to the off side.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Length on middle, played with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Fuller on off, Azam hits it through mid on for one.
FOUR! This time in much better control. Outside off, Sohail goes back and punches it off his back foot through covers for a boundary.
In line of the stumps, Sohail blocks the wickets and bunts it down.
Pitches it up on middle and leg, Sohail on-drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! Deliberately done? Length ball outside off, Sohail plays it late, almost like he got an outside edge to it. Third man is not fine enough and the ball meets the fence.
Full on leg, Azam works it through square leg and takes a run.
Sohail guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller in line, hit back to the bowler.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Sohail has punched the ball off the back foot.

NOT OUT! Wide given. Down leg, Sohail looks to work it to the on side but misses the ball. Latham takes off the bails and puts in an appeal. The umpire takes it up and replay shows that he got his foot back in time.
A stumping appeal is taken up. Look's safe.
Back of a length ball on off, pushed to long on for another run.
Down leg again, turned around the corner for one.
Full and down leg, Sohail works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Colin Munro to bowl his first over.
Fuller in length on middle, Sohail strokes it to long on for another single. So an expensive start to Boult's new spell. 9 from this one.
FOUR! Up and over! Full and on the middle, Sohail lofts it over the mid on fielder and a boundary results.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shuffles right across and works it around the corner for a run.
Back of a length on off, Azam stands tall and defends it out.
Full and on off, the batsman finds the cover fielder with a drive.
Down the leg side, Azam misses the flick and it has been given as a wide.
Trent Boult in for another spell.

FOUR! Full toss and it gets the treatment it deserves. It is picked over the mid-wicket fielder. It is in the gap and a boundary results. Spoils what was a good over till then. So runs are still coming at a good rate despite the loss of Zaman's wicket.
Floats it up on off, Azam times it to long off for a single.
The googly on off, Azam picks it and with the turn works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, Azam guides it to point.
Turns it with the turn around the corner for a run.
Flighted ball on middle, this is eased down to long on for a run.
Just a little outside off, it is guided down to third man for a run.
This is flicked uppishly through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! A short ball from Colin, it just sits up to be hit. Easy-peasy for Sohail. He pulls it over mid-wicket and a boundary results.
Just ahead of a length on off, the batter times it back towards the bowler.
Length again around off, Haris gets behind the line and blocks it out.
Good length on off, the batsman pushes it to covers.

FOUR! Poor ball and put away! Short and wide outside off, Azam has all the time in the world, to go back, pick the gap and cut it through backward point. A boundary, second in the over. 10 from this one.
Nicely bowled! Gives this a nice loop on off, it pitches and then turns away. Azam goes for a drive but gets an outside edge towards short third man.
Cleverly plays it with the turn through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet! He dances down the track, gets to the pitch of it and times it through extra cover. The ball races away. Gets off the mark with a very confident looking stroke.
The leg spinner on middle, the batsman works it towards square leg.
On the shorter side, it is worked around the corner for a single.
Fullish and on off, Sohail strokes it to covers. Two runs and a wicket from this over. Excellent stuff.
Works this with the angle towards mid-wicket.
Bowls it on off, HS keeps it out.
Haris Sohail is the new man in.

OUT! Zaman holes out! He has thrown it away! Zaman was playing so good till now. He dances down the track and tries to go downtown. Ends up mistiming it up in the air towards long on. Henry there settles under it and takes an easy catch. A much-needed wicket and a big one as Zaman looked set for a huge innings. He walks back disappointed and New Zealand will now try to get things under their control.
Angles it onto the pads, it is worked down to fine leg for a single.
On the stumps, Azam works it to mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, Azam fails to flick it away. Wided.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to square leg.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.
Down the leg side, spinning too much, Zaman misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman plays the pull-shot. They pick up a single.
On middle and around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.
Full and around middle, Zaman paddles it through fine leg for one.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Comes down the track, hits it hard towards the bowler who sticks out his right hand. The ball bursts down to long on where Colin Munro makes a decent save. A single taken.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
FOUR! Solid shot. Full and outside off, Fakhar lofts it straight back over the bowler's head for a boundary!

Huge, huge, appeal for LBW! Turned down! Sodhi wants a review, Latham does not. 'Bat?' asks Sodhi to the umpire. Gets a nod. Replays confirm. Full on middle, Zaman gets down and tries to play the paddle but misses and is hit on the pads. Looks dead plumb but there is glove involved.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Dropped short, pulled away for a single.
FOUR! A length ball on middle, Zaman comes down the track and smashes it  straight back over the bowler's head.
On middle and off, punched towards mid on.
Outside off, pushed through point for a quick one.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for one.
Full and down the leg side, swept through square leg for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, Zaman flicks it through square leg for a single.
DRINKS BREAK. Here comes Ish Sodhi.
Good length delivery on off stump, the batsman defends on the front foot.
Length delivery on off stump, Babar plays it towards third man. The batsmen take two runs.
Good length delivery on middle stump, the batsman defends on the back foot.
HUGE APPEAL FOR LBW! NOT OUT! Length delivery on off stump, Babar gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Babar defends on the back foot.
TOP EDGE AND SAFE!  Bowls short on middle stump, Zaman gets a top edge but it lands towards the mid on region. No fielder had come there to take the catch. The batsmen take a single.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
A bouncer on middle, Zaman ducks.
Outside off, Babar taps it through point for a single.
Outside off, punched straight to point.
On a good length outside off, solidly defended.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Babar played it towards mid on. The batsmen take a single.
Again on a good length on middle stump, Babar defends on the back foot.
Length delivery on off stump, Zaman plays it towards third man. The batsmen take a single.
Bowls full on leg stump, the batsman flicked it towards the leg side. The batsmen take a single.
Length delivery on off stump, the batsman defends on the front foot.
WIDE! Bowls way down the leg side, Babar lets it go.
Length delivery on off stump, Zaman hits it towards mid on. The batsmen take a single.
Babar Azam comes in next, at number 3, replacing the Professor.

OUT! A hit wicket it is! That is a sad, sad way to go. A length ball, down the leg side, Hafeez looks to flick and does so. However, while finishing that shot, we hear the sound of a bail fall. The keeper sees it first and appeals. Hafeez looks back and knows what has happened. Does not even complete the run. Lockie pats him on the back, as a bit of a comfort. The umpires though, get together and then refer it upstairs. Replays shows that the right leg just went a bit too far into the crease. Bonus wicket for New Zealand.
Ho ho ho! What do we have here? The Kiwis have appealed for a hit wicket dismissal against Hafeez. They are confident while Hafeez looks desolate. Now then, referred upstairs...
Short again, width again, Hafeez looks to cut but is done in by the pace. Slashes hard once more, only to miss.
Short and outside off, a slash and a miss.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Outside off, played straight to point.
On middle and leg, helped through square leg for a single.
Full on middle stump, the left-hander drives it towards mid on. The batsmen take a single.
Length delivery on middle stump, Hafeez flicks it towards the leg side. The batsmen take a single.
Length delivery on middle stump, Zaman drives it towards the mid on region. The batsmen take a single.
FOUR! Edge. Short outside off stump, Zaman gets an outside edge past the keeper as he looks to defend and it races away for a boundary to third man.
Length delivery on off stump, the left-hander flicks it to mid-wicket.
Around off, punched back to the bowler.
Length delivery on middle stump, Hafeez defends on the back foot.
Full on leg stump, the left-hander drives it towards mid on. The batsmen take a single.
Full on off stump, Zaman drives it towards covers.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
FOUR! Full on middle, Zaman flicks it through mid-wicket and finds the gap and the boundary!
On a length outside off, Zaman pushes inside the line and is beaten.
Short on off stump, the left-hander cuts it towards point. The batsmen take a single.
Good length delivery on off stump, Fakhar cuts it to point.
Length delivery on middle stump, Hafeez drives it towards mid on. The batsmen take a single.
Again on a length on middle stump, Hafeez defends on the back foot.
Full on leg stump, Fakhar drives it towards mid on. The batsmen take a single.
Length delivery on leg stump, Zaman tucks it to leg side.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, Colin de Granhomme is into the attack.

On the pads again, Zaman tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pad. The ball rolls towards the square leg region and a run is taken. End of Powerplay 1 and it is a good one for Pakistan, they are 48 for 0.
Zaman is now down on the ground. The physio has made his way out. Do not think the spray will do him a favor here. He now though seems fine to continue.
On a length and around middle, Zaman tries to flick but misses. The ball hits him around the box. He is in a little pain.
Fuller in length on middle, it is flicked down to fine leg for a couple.
Back of a length on off, Hafeez tries to push but he gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
Back of a length on off, Hafeez hops and keeps it out.
On a length and outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Lockie Ferguson to bowl.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
A full toss and it is driven back towards the bowler. Henry shows good aggression as he throws it back towards the stumps.

Just short again! Another short ball and it is well-directed. Zaman goes for the pull but it hits his glove and lobs towards short fine leg. The fielder first thinks of going for it but then pulls out.
Around off, Zaman defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! Top shot! Henry bowls it a little too full on off, Zaman shows the full face of the bat and strokes it down to the long off fence.
On the shorter side and it is pitched on middle, Hafeez works it around the corner and takes a single.
On the pads again, Hafeez flicks it through square leg, a run taken. A better over from Boult, just three from it.
On the pads, Hafeez tries to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
This is stroked towards covers for a single.

In the air... but does not carry! Hafeez dances down the track but Boult spots it. He bangs it short on middle, MH goes for the pull but is late on the shot. He mistimes it towards mid on. A run taken.
Good length on off, the batsman lunges and blocks it out.
Good delivery! Not very short and just outside off, slanting away with the angle. Hafeez tries to play it through the point region but the ball was too close to do so. Whizzes past the outside edge.
Good length and around middle, kept out.
On the shorter side, Zaman defends it onto the ground.

Goes fuller and around off, Zaman pushes it to mid off. This is what they have to bowl to Zaman. Right on the off pole or just outside it. They have sprayed it too much on the pads in the pursuit of not giving him room.

FOUR! Uppish but well over the fielder! Straying on the pads once again, Zaman says thank you so much as he flicks it over the square leg fielder and the ball goes to the fence. Zaman is dealing in boundaries here.
On the shorter side, Zaman plays the pull, it is hit well but to the fielder at square leg. Two dots to begin this over.
Good length on middle, Zaman keeps it out.
This is what he needs to bowl on a consistent basis. Length and around off, Hafeez stands tall and keeps it out. 9 from this one too and Boult is going at over 6 per over.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Once again Boult is a little too straight and he is flicked through square leg and the ball races away. Boult has not been at his best here.
FOUR! But he can't bowl that straight. Too full and on the pads, Zaman flicks it through wide mid on, beating the dive of the fielder and a boundary results.
Shortens his length a touch and bowls it on middle, Zaman works it to mid-wicket. They have decided to bowl very straight to the left-hander, not giving him room.
Fuller in length on middle, the batsman works it to mid on.
Good running! Zaman pushes this down to mid off and takes a brisk single.
Slightly straighter in line and it is clipped to square leg.
Works it with the angle towards square leg for a run.
Back of a length and closer to the off pole. The batsman stands tall and keeps it out.
On the pads, it is clipped down to fine leg for a run.
Edged but a run! Hafeez is guilty of pushing at a ball outside off with hard hands. It takes the outside edge and goes down to third man for a single.
A little width on offer and Zaman loves it. He strokes it through covers. The ball does not go to the fence but the batsmen run two. 9 from the over, a good one for Pakistan.
On the stumps, giving Zaman no room at all. Fakhar defends it onto the ground.

Excellent save! A little too straight and Hafeez clips it nicely through wide mid on. Ferguson gives it a chase and with a slide he seems to have pushed the ball back into play. The umpires go upstairs to check and replays show that the pacer has done really well.
A couple! Nice shot! Not a driving length delivery around middle, Hafeez just leans into it and times it down the ground for a brace.
This one is angled into the pads of the batsman, a scrambled seam delivery. The batter tries to flick but misses to get hit onto the pads. It rolls towards point and the batsmen run a leg bye.
A little bit of shape into the batter from middle, Hafeez works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Edge and wide. Outside off, Hafeez is drawn forward. He gets a fat edge which flies past the slip fielder. They cross as the ball rolls to third man.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
FOUR! Lovely! First boundary of the innings. Full and outside off, Hafeez leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary. 3 fielders chase that but to no avail.
Better from Henry. Drags it a bit back outside off, Hafeez plays for the straighter one and gets beaten.
Good shot but even better stop from Watling. Hafeez drives this to covers but BJ there dives to his right and saves it.
Fuller on the leg side, turned towards square leg for one.
A bit hesitation but safe in the end. Hafeez helps it to the on side and sets off for a run. A bit hesitation before his partner sends him back. Good start from Trent, just the one from it.
Similar length this time outside off, Zaman punches it off the back foot through cover-point to get off strike.
Back of a length ball down leg, Zaman works it to the on side for nothing.
On a good length around off, played with a straight bat by Fakhar.
Fuller again on middle and leg, Zaman gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Full and on off, Zaman drives it but can't get any timing on that one. Gives it to the man at covers.
Trent Boult to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Good start from Henry. Bowls this closer to the off pole, Hafeez plays it with soft hands to the off side.
A bit fuller way outside off, Hafeez is not bothered to poke at it.
On a good length outside off, Hafeez shoulders his arms to it.
Full and on middle, Zaman does well to jam it through mid-wicket. The ball runs away and they come back for the third run. Fakhar and Pakistan are up and running.
Bowls this one on a good length over the stumps. Zaman looks to play it with a straight bat but gets hit on his thigh pad.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands it full on the pads. Fakhar looks to flick it away but gets hit on his pads outside leg.
Out come the players along with the umpires. Fakhar Zaman and Mohammad Hafeez will open the batting for the hosts. Matt Henry to bowl with the new ball. No slips in place. Interesting.

Team news - Some big changes for both sides. Some forced while the others tactical. For the hosts, Imam-ul-Haq and Imad Wasim are out while Asif Ali and Haris Sohail get the nod. Skipper Kane Williamson has suffered a groin strain and will miss this game. Tom Latham will captain the side while BJ Watling comes in for Kane. Also, Matt Henry replaces Tim Southee.
TOSS - Pakistan win the toss and will bat.

Hello and welcome to the third and final ODI between Pakistan and New Zealand. Pakistan would be looking to win the series. They made a great comeback in the last match restricting the visitors to a very paltry score in the last match. Their openers did the job and they will be hoping for more of the same tonight. On the other hand, New Zealand will hope their batting clicks tonight. Ross Taylor has been in great form but they would want others to step up especially, Williamson. Pakistan will be missing the absence of Imam-ul-Haq who got retired hurt in the last match while batting. Should be a cracker of a decider. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.
